user_story: As a user, I want to navigate between different iframe examples on the Frames page so that I can view various frame implementations. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click on the link with text 'Nested Frames', I should be redirected to the URL '/nested_frames'. 2. When I click on the link with text 'iFrame', I should be redirected to the URL '/iframe'. 3. The heading 'Frames' must be visible on the page.
